python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,hashlib
d=json.load(open('reports/review-context/epic-195-a7-compatibility-spec-a19r1-a-invocation.json'))
t="\n".join(e['path']+"\t"+e['sha256'] for e in d['allowed_input_manifest'])
i=hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest()
r="|".join([str(d['sequence']),d['stage'],d['role'],d['run_id'],d['host_session_id'],d['previous_record_sha256'],"allowed-inputs-v1",i])
h=hashlib.sha256(r.encode()).hexdigest()
q="0599e72ba9a2382aad1b7540bfbc7f45b3424abaefc010fb686933e4d9964a95"
print("indep_input",i);print("indep_record",h)
print("equal",h==q)
c=h[:-1]+('0' if h[-1]!='0' else '1')
print("mutated",c,"equal",c==q)
EOF
